note: Structural predicate for the reported illegal code motion. The repro's source computes CalculateLevelOfDetailUnclamped unconditionally, then branches on `all(uv < 0.5)`. The symptom is present when the disassembly places the dx.op.calculateLOD *call* inside the label block that is only reached by the branch's true arm, rather than in the unconditional entry block before the `br i1`. The capturing group anchors the label search to the specific successor block named by the branch (not just 'some later label'), and the block body is bounded by a negative lookahead so it cannot walk past the next `; <label>:` or the function's closing `}` into the trailing `declare float @dx.op.calculateLOD.f32` line, which is present in every capture regardless of the bug and would otherwise make this match unconditionally (measured: an earlier unbounded version of this regex matched even the -Od control, because it kept scanning through the whole rest of the file for the literal substring 'dx.op.calculateLOD' and found the declaration). Control: `variant-control-od-main-debug.txt` (same repro.hlsl, `-Od` added) places the call in the entry block instead and must score no-match -- confirming the predicate discriminates sunk-vs-not-sunk rather than matching on the mere presence of calculateLOD anywhere in the file.
